The EXF-10KM-5K Fiber Extender is a high-performance extender based on the SDVoE solution, specifically designed to transmit uncompressed 5120x1440p video and high-fidelity audio up to 10 kilometers (10KM) over a 10G fiber link. Its key advantage is zero end-to-end latency (<120mu s), which is critical for real-time applications, combined with robust support for HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.2 standards, including high frame rates (up to 240Hz for 1080p). Built from durable sheet steel with secure screw-lock power connectors, this system ensures professional-grade reliability and pristine signal quality, making it an ideal choice for extending demanding video sources over long distances without any loss in fidelity or speed.

The product is based on the SDVoE solution and supports the highest quality video format, including 5120 x 2160p 4:2:0 or 4K@60Hz with full 4:4:4 color space and High Dynamic Range (HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, and Dolby Vision low latency mode).

Utilizing the included 10G SFP+ single-mode optical transceivers, the extender is capable of sending the full-fidelity signal up to 10 kilometers (10KM) over fiber, far exceeding the distance limitations of copper HDMI cables.

The extender supports high-end audio formats, including LPCM (up to 7.1 channel/192kHz), Dolby True HD, and DTS-HD Master. Furthermore, it ensures perfect compatibility by passing the display's EDID to the video source transparently.
